blocks.html:
GeoChat is WinTAK's built-in text messaging. Use it to coordinate with your unit without leaving the map.

Draft: written without screenshots. Add WinTAK GeoChat screenshots when available.

slides.title: Open GeoChat
slides.html:
Open GeoChat from the WinTAK toolbar.

  • It lists your conversations — all-chat, teams/groups, and individual users.

slides.title: Choose who you're messaging
slides.html: Pick the recipient: the whole net (All Chat Rooms), a specific team / group, or a single user. Sending to the right scope keeps the net clean and respects OPSEC.

slides.title: Send a message
slides.html: Type your message and send. Keep it short and unambiguous; follow your unit's reporting format and use cover terms for sensitive detail.

slides.title: Messages and the map
slides.html: GeoChat is geo-aware — messages can carry a location, and you can jump from a message to the point on the map it refers to. For longer or formatted reporting, use the prescribed messaging tools per your unit's standing orders.
